ios.desc:
Join the #1 app for chores in 2025, the ultimate chore app that makes it fun and easy to manage chores! Loved by thousands of families worldwide, our chores tracker and family chore manager transforms daily tasks into an engaging experience, helping you keep everyone motivated and on schedule.

Take control of your household routine with powerful features like a customizable chore chart, dashboards showing missed and completed chores, and the ability to assign rewards and time to chores so work is split evenly. Whether you’re tracking family tasks or setting up a house chores cleaning schedule, this user-friendly chores app will keep everyone accountable. With our task-tracking tools, you can coordinate a seamless cleaning schedule, streamline kids chores, and reclaim precious family time. Download now to discover why we’re the go-to chore app for busy families everywhere!

FEATURES
- Color-coded chore chart
- Interactive dashboard to see what chores have been completed or missed
- Set an estimated time to completion for each task, so chores are distributed fairly
- Require approval for chores before they’re marked complete
- Send reminders to complete chores for your home
- Rotate chores between any home members on a weekly or monthly basis
- Add comments for extra context

With a premium subscription, enjoy:
- Add specific steps for each chore for enhanced detail
- Some chores can be done anytime—set those to be done by the end of the week or month
- Pause chores temporarily for anyone, anytime
- Set Priority levels so your home knows what’s most important

quotes.text:
After years of household tension over who was supposed to do what, I created a chore management app I wished existed. For me, existing solutions either felt over-engineered or just lacking in features. I wanted to make something simple enough that my family would actually use it, but customizable enough to handle its quirks.

If this sounds like something your home can get behind, It would mean the world if you could check it out and give some honest feedback. In what ways can I help your family/roommates/anyone else through my app?
